title: Broken Hearted Cosmic Bear
description: A large anthropomorphic blue bear stands centered, holding a glowing cosmic heart that drips with red and purple liquid. The bear's body is covered in starry night patterns and ocean waves, set against a background of shattered glass revealing ancient ruined columns under a pink and orange sunset sky.
prompt: Anthropomorphic blue bear with starry fur and ocean wave patterns around its neck, standing and holding a large glowing cosmic heart that drips red and purple liquid. The bear has a sad expression. The entire image is framed as if viewed through shattered glass with golden cracks. In the background are ancient ruined stone columns under a dramatic pink and orange sunset sky with soft clouds.
